## Description

Please provide a concise summary of the changes made in this PR, including the motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or API endpoint
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring with no external behavior changes
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `test`: New or modified tests
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, configuration, or dependency updates
- [ ] `ci`: Continuous integration adjustments

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(material): add pagination validation`).
- [ ] **Tests ship with the change**: This PR includes automated tests covering the new behavior or bug fix.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run format:check` and all files are correctly formatted.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run lint` with 0 errors.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run typecheck` with 0 errors.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run test:cov` and verified coverage meets or exceeds configured thresholds.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run build` and the production bundle builds with 0 errors.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation in `README.md` / `docs/` where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are included in this commit.
